summary: Rebuilt all three documents from the bytes the four accepted reviews now hold after the visual review returned the run to the study (author-study 3-7, derive-synthesis 3-4, derive-homily 5, each re-reviewed): the 38-page expansive study (a5705241a178bc453e6a93c23f9f6e9201faac8630361470830e51b839dc05d5), the 12-page concise study (126bf160fb5de7e936399c24396d8bc93b46126e736e5f2d0b0a348591959dd7) and the 5-page homily (923fb4936d107d3dec13fc6cf1b7a9197aed5dbb1ef19ae20cc5bb8f2d2fb289). Each settles in exactly two passes, and a cold build from a fully removed auxiliary set and a warm build from the settled one produced byte-identical PDFs, auxiliary files and contents file, so these are a fixed point. All three logs are clean (no error, no LaTeX, package or class warning, no overfull or underfull box, no missing character, no rerun request); the bounded right running head introduced at author-study iteration 3 raises no warning. PDF structure, metadata, font embedding (7, 9 and 6 resources, every face embedded, subsetted and Unicode-mapped) and text extraction all check out: no replacement or control character, 19,357 / 7,441 / 2,361 extracted words, and the four ae-ligature accents extract as the canonically equivalent decomposition. Ghostscript renders every page of all three without a diagnostic, ModDate on each is D:20260919081000Z from the tracked revision timestamp with no build-clock CreationDate and no trailer id, and no page is blank or heading-only. The page counts satisfy the 20-50 and 10-12 ranges, and the concise auxiliary file settles the physical-page markers at absolute pages with \abspage equal to \page at every one: inventory, overview and all four sense markers on 1, chronology on 2, themes 3 to 4, commentary beginning on 5. No layout repair was required, so no render source, revision timestamp or content seal was touched; the only working-tree changes are the snapshot the helper replaced at research/artifacts.json and the iteration-2 production audit appended to research/production-review.md. The artifacts-phase gate command, the per-edition component checks for all three editions, the leaf content preflight over its twelve checks and the separate provenance-matches-run check against this run's header all pass, and 55 bounded page rasters with 55 thumbnails and 4 contact sheets are prepared in this stage's raster child, with the PDFs, logs, auxiliary files, extracted text, the contents file and their digests kept beside it. Every review seal is current: the research seal over its 2,054 files and 12 chronology computation inputs, the study seal over its 19, the concise seal over its 14 and the homily seal over its 7 each hash exactly as the accepted review recorded them, with no mismatch, and all 79 recorded stage results still hash as the run recorded them. Compared with the reviewed proofs the homily PDF is byte-identical and all three auxiliary files are byte-identical; the study and concise PDFs differ in one printed line only, the Last revised colophon the later shared timestamp moved to 2026-09-19T08:10:00Z. No semantic defect was found to report upstream. Nothing is installed and no page has had an independent visual review.
